We recently celebrated a birthday at Suraj Farms, and it was a wonderful experience. The venue is beautifully maintained with plenty of greenery and open space, which created the perfect setting for the occasion.

The staff was cooperative and attentive, making sure everything went smoothly. The food was delicious, and the arrangements were spot on. Everyone truly enjoyed the celebration, and it turned into a memorable day for all of us.

Suraj Farms is a great choice for birthdays, gatherings, or team celebrations. Highly recommended!

I was there for two days to attend my best friend’s wedding. The food and services were pretty nice. They have huge lawns and pool and space for other fun activities for the guests to engage. Rooms can use some improvements.

Overall it was a nice experience.
